cuelith.richtext.idle: Open a text in an editor that supports formatted words and select some words.
cuelith.richtext.selectSome: Select some words in the text.
cuelith.richtext.noItalic: The typeface in use has no true italic: pick another one from the text styles.
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.1.title: Open a text
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.1.body: Open the editor of a text or song that supports formatted words: this panel turns on by itself.
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.2.title: Select some words
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.2.body: Select the words to change in the text, then choose size, bold, italic or colour from this panel.
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.3.title: The text stays plain
cuelith.richtext.onboarding.3.body: The text does not change: the formatting sits next to it, and anything that does not know about it reads the usual text.
